name: goal-run
description: Set a goal at the start of a session: Claude plans the tasks, you approve, and a pixel Claude in running shoes runs a 0-100% track as the tasks get done, with each task's token cost

askOnStart.title: Ask for a goal when a session starts
askOnStart.description: on asks above the prompt at the start of each session (or offers to continue an unfinished goal); off waits for /session-goal
